CustomApplication.description: Lightning console app seeded so the live UTAM harness can exercise console-only page objects (navex console tabs, header stageLeftToggle, workspace tabs) that a standard desktop app never renders. A utility bar is intentionally NOT attached yet — the hand-authored utility-bar FlexiPage was removed until its template name can be validated against a live org (two guesses — flexipage:utilityBarTemplateDesktop and flexipage:utilityBar — were both rejected by the Metadata API). The console nav surfaces this app provides are the higher-value, lower-risk target and deploy on their own.
CustomApplication.label: UTAM Console
